Fractal: mandelbulb: 3D Mandelbrot power fractal. menger: Menger sponge. kifs: kaleidoscopic IFS folding fractal.
Iterations: Detail level, 1-16 (Menger max 8). Higher = finer detail and slower.
Power: Mandelbulb: power (8 is classic). KIFS: scale, clamped to 1.2-4 (2 when above 5). Menger ignores it.
Size: Overall size of the fractal in world units.
Foldoffset: KIFS only: offset applied at each fold.
Foldrotate: KIFS only: rotation per iteration in degrees.
Color2: Colour blended in by the orbit trap, tinting the crevices.
